Module com.mycompany.urbanlegends
Package game

Class PositionGenerator

java.lang.Object
game.PositionGenerator
public class PositionGenerator extends Object
Generates random positions within a predefined map boundary. This class provides methods to obtain random x and y coordinates for placing game elements on a grid or map.
Author:
joxan, melani, fabian, jorge, ismael
